seoTitle: Add a Coming Soon Page to Your Squarespace Site
metaDescription: Learn two ways to add a coming soon page to Squarespace: setting a cover page as your homepage or using site-wide password protection.
intro: Whether you're preparing for launch or working on a redesign, a coming soon page keeps visitors informed while the rest of your site stays hidden. This guide covers two methods: using a cover page as your temporary homepage, and enabling site-wide password protection for a maintenance mode effect.

steps.heading: Create a new page
steps.body: In Pages, scroll to the Not Linked section and add a Blank Page or Cover Page named something like Coming Soon.

steps.heading: Design the coming soon page
steps.body: Add a bold heading, a short message, your logo, social links, or an email capture form to start building your audience early.

steps.heading: Set it as your homepage
steps.body: Open the page's settings and enable Set as Homepage, then save, so visitors only see this page.

steps.heading: Or use site-wide password protection
steps.body: Go to Settings, then Site Availability, and select Password Protected as an alternative approach.

steps.heading: Set a password and message
steps.body: Enter a password and a short message like Site Coming Soon, then save to lock the entire site.

steps.heading: Combine both methods if needed
steps.body: Pair your coming soon page with password protection so you can still collect emails while the full site stays hidden.

faq.question: What's the difference between the two coming soon methods?
faq.answer: One sets a cover page as your homepage while the rest of the site stays unlinked; the other password-protects the entire site.

faq.question: Can I collect emails on my coming soon page?
faq.answer: Yes, you can add an email capture form to your coming soon page to build your subscriber list before launch.

faq.question: Where do I enable password protection?
faq.answer: Go to Settings, then Site Availability, and choose Password Protected.

faq.question: Will visitors see the rest of my site while it's coming soon?
faq.answer: No, with the cover page method the rest of your site stays in the Not Linked section, and with password protection the whole site is locked.

faq.question: Can I remove the coming soon page later?
faq.answer: Yes, once you're ready to launch, you can change the homepage setting or disable password protection.
